allowed_next.title: Allowed Next
allowed_next.description: Legal next statuses (ARCHITECTURE §9.1). The UI offers only these.

previous_status.title: Previous Status
previous_status.description: `from_status` of the latest event. PATCHing back to it undoes that event.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Stored on the status event when `status` changes.

ApplicationPatch.title: ApplicationPatch
ApplicationPatch.description: Only fields present in the request are changed.

status.title: Status
status.description: The job's application status; `ny` when no application exists.

is_new.title: Is New
is_new.description: First seen after the previous scheduled run.

description.title: Description
description.description: Cleaned ad text; null when only the title is known.

status.title: Status
status.description: The job's application status; `ny` when no application exists.

is_new.title: Is New
is_new.description: First seen after the previous scheduled run.

fallback_calls.title: Fallback Calls
fallback_calls.description: Calls this backend made as the fallback for another backend (`agent_runs.fallback_from`).

estimated.title: Estimated
estimated.description: True for `claude_code`: the cost is an estimate, the subscription pays.

month_start.title: Month Start
month_start.description: First day of the current Oslo calendar month.

by_backend.title: By Backend
by_backend.description: This month, one row per backend with calls (claude_code and openrouter always present).

daily.title: Daily
daily.description: Last 30 days (today included), one row per day and backend with calls.

balance_usd.title: Balance Usd
balance_usd.description: Credit left: account balance (`account`) or the key's remaining limit (`key_limit`).

total_credits_usd.title: Total Credits Usd
total_credits_usd.description: Account credits bought, or the key's limit. Null when unknown.

balance_source.title: Balance Source
balance_source.description: Null when the balance is unknown (key without limit, no management key) or not configured.

base_hash.title: Base Hash
base_hash.description: Hash the edit started from; a mismatch gives 409.

values.title: Values
values.description: Key → new value. `null` removes the override.
